decisions.reason: A two-component glass flake spraying system is a specialized application of the firm's core spraying technology, and dropping it one year after launch is unlikely even though it is only mentioned on the website.
The low-pressure injection pump has its own product page, which signals commitment, and it fits the firm's core pump portfolio.
The low-pressure material transfer pump is a standard complementary product that supports system sales, so it is likely kept despite its lower web visibility.
Fire protection flow monitoring has a dedicated page and serves a regulated market with steady demand, so the firm will likely keep it for now.
